summary.text: Ed Clere is a member of the Indiana House representing District 72, which includes most of Floyd County, and has served since 2008.
The caucus page, which describes him as serving his fourth term, lists his service on the Ways and Means, Education and Public Policy committees.

paragraphs.text: Clere earned a bachelor's degree in sociology from Indiana University Southeast and has worked as a Realtor since 2001.
The page says he coaches youth soccer, serves on the board of the New Albany-Floyd County Habitat for Humanity affiliate, and lives in New Albany with his wife, Amy, and their five children.
